attr.title: Ren'Py Engine Runner (mkrp)
attr.desc: PortMaster Lightweight Runner for Ren'Py visual novels (Ren'Py 8 & 7).
attr.inst: Copy your Ren'Py game folder contents (game/ folder containing .rpa or .rpyc files) into ports/mkrp/game/
attr.portdesc: PortMaster Ren'Py port template and runtime configuration optimized for handheld devices (Knulli, ROCKNIX, ArkOS).
